items.title: Build-to-rent homes could appeal to young S’poreans, but can rent be kept under $2,000?
items.description: Can Singapore build-to-rent homes stay under $2,000 a month? What that means for renters saving to buy, and for landlords.

items.title: Why Singapore is exploring build-to-rent
items.description: Why Singapore is exploring build-to-rent, and what it means for people who rent now and hope to buy an HDB flat or condo later.

items.title: 1,310 flats in Sembawang with under 3 years’ wait to go on sale in Nov
items.description: About 1,310 Sembawang Anchor BTO flats, with a wait of about 2 years 10 months, go on sale in November 2026. What HDB buyers should check.

items.title: Thomson Reserve sells 90% of units at average of S$2,900 psf over launch weekend
items.description: Thomson Reserve sold 1,143 of 1,268 units at about $2,900 psf. What new launch buyers and nearby resale sellers should compare.

items.title: One in five prime-region private home resale deals sold at a loss in Q3
items.description: One in five prime-region private resales sold at a loss in Q3 2026, Business Times reported. What buyers and sellers should check.

items.title: New mall, parks and plans for a school under Toa Payoh West masterplan
items.description: Toa Payoh Hillside offers about 1,600 BTO flats beside Caldecott MRT in November 2026, inside a plan for 6,000 homes. What is real today.

items.title: Rare, roomy and pricey? Inside Singapore's niche jumbo HDB flat market
items.description: CNA calls jumbo HDB flats rare, roomy and pricey. What buyers should check before paying extra for the space.

items.title: HDB publishes Q3 resale flat prices by town, listing the cheapest & most expensive areas
items.description: HDB published Q3 2026 resale prices by town. Buyers and sellers should read their own town, not one national number.

items.title: Ex-condo chairman loses defamation suit over undisclosed links
items.description: A former condo chairman lost a defamation case over undisclosed links. What Singapore condo buyers and sellers should ask about the estate.

items.title: Private home launch pipeline set to climb to 14-year high in 2027
items.description: About 14,800 private homes could launch in 2027, the most since 2013. What that means for HDB upgraders and resale sellers.

items.title: Whopping $1.818 mil transacted price for a Dawson five-room flat — all-time high in Singapore per HDB data
items.description: A Dawson five-room HDB flat sold for S$1.818 million, EdgeProp reported from HDB data. What that record does and does not mean.

items.title: Hao Mart founder halts foreclosure of his Jervois Hill bungalow by OG
items.description: A Jervois Hill bungalow foreclosure was halted. What one landed loan does, and does not, say about Singapore property prices.

items.title: Hong Leong, TID place top bid of S$181.86m or S$1,755 psf ppr for Orchard plot
items.description: Hong Leong and TID bid $181.86 million for an Orchard plot, about $1,755 psf of floor area. Why that is not a condo price.

items.title: Two Tiong Bahru HDB blocks to get HIP upgrade after re-poll
items.description: Two Tiong Bahru HDB blocks will get HIP after a fresh poll. What owners pay for, and what resale buyers should still check.

items.title: Tampines is S’pore’s most populous planning area, but not its fastest-growing
items.description: Tampines has the most people of any planning area, but Punggol and Sengkang grew faster. How to choose a mature town or a growing one.

items.title: About 11,000 homes planned on Maju Forest, Gillman Barracks sites with more greenery to be retained
items.description: About 11,000 homes are planned at Maju Forest and Gillman Barracks, including 9,500 public homes. What nearby buyers and sellers should treat as a long-term.

items.title: Bukit Sembawang Plans Central Singapore Condo Project After $153M Site Buy
items.description: Bukit Sembawang plans a central Singapore condo after a $153 million site buy. That number is land cost, not a unit price.

items.title: ‘Supply onslaught’ to weigh on HDB resale market in 2027, but cash-rich buyers to support prices
items.description: An EdgeProp headline says 2027 HDB supply may weigh on resale prices, while cash-rich buyers could still support them.

items.title: Which locations will draw strong demand at Singapore’s November BTO launch?
items.description: Where will November’s BTO launch draw demand? Rank towns by commute, flat type and waiting time, not by the headline.

items.title: Million-dollar HDB resale transactions in Singapore climb to record 597 in Q3
items.description: Million-dollar HDB resales hit a record 597 in Q3 2026. That count is the top end, not the price of a typical flat.

items.title: HDB Q3 resale prices dip 0.1% even as more flats sold
items.description: HDB resale prices dipped 0.1% in Q3 2026 while more flats sold. What that small move means for one purchase or sale.

items.title: Home sales set to recover in Q4 with prices seen rising further on new launch momentum
items.description: Home sales are expected to recover in Q4 on new-launch momentum. That is a forecast, not a reason to skip the numbers on one home.

items.title: Easy to rent out, hard to sell: Buyers could be losing interest in one-bedroom condos
items.description: One-bedroom condos can be easy to rent and hard to sell. Investors should check resale demand, not only the rent.

items.title: HDB resale transactions jump 19.5% q-o-q in 3Q2026 amid policy changes
items.description: HDB resale deals jumped 19.5% in Q3 2026. That is more transactions, not a 19.5% rise in prices.

items.title: Even The Cheapest 4-Room HDB Flats Aren't Cheap Anymore — One Statistic Reveals Just How Rare $500K Flats Are
items.description: S$500,000 4-room HDB flats are described as rare. Check the town and the lease before you treat that number as the market.

items.title: En bloc sales of old condos: Offer affected owners ABSD concessions for replacement homes
items.description: A commentary says en bloc owners should get ABSD relief on a replacement home. That is an argument, not a new rule.

items.title: Reno content creator lambasts ‘most pathetic’ 4-room Tengah BTO kitchen, HDB responds
items.description: A creator criticised a 4-room Tengah BTO kitchen and HDB responded. Buyers should measure the plan, not the clip.

items.title: Home buyers using more cash and CPF savings to fund down payments
items.description: Buyers are putting more cash and CPF into down payments. A bigger upfront sum lowers the loan and also empties savings.

items.title: The Serra Residences sells less than a quarter of units released at average S$3,460 psf
items.description: The Serra Residences sold under a quarter of released units at about S$3,460 psf. Ask what was released before you judge the project.

items.title: GCB Market Activities picks up pace on “realistic pricing”
items.description: Good Class Bungalow deals picked up when pricing was more realistic. There is no new price in the headline.

items.title: New private home sales nearly double in September to 296 units
items.description: Developers sold 296 new private homes in September, nearly double the month before. That is a sales count, not a price jump.

items.title: EL Development puts in sole bid for Marina Gardens Lane site at S$450m or S$1,243 psf ppr
items.description: EL Development’s sole bid for Marina Gardens Lane was S$450 million, or S$1,243 psf of floor area. That is land cost, not a unit price.

items.title: Freehold condo Amber Park in District 15 notches fresh record high of $3,170 psf
items.description: Amber Park in District 15 set a project record at S$3,170 psf. Ask the unit size before you treat it as the east’s price.

items.title: HDB resale prices have fallen for three straight quarters. So should you make your move now, or wait?
items.description: HDB resale prices have fallen for three straight quarters. Buy or wait based on the flat and the loan, not on timing the bottom.

items.title: Late Singapore property tycoon's freehold bungalow put on sale at nearly $65M
items.description: A late tycoon’s freehold bungalow is listed at nearly $65 million. That is an asking price for one house, not a sale.

items.title: District 5 Condo Prices 2026: $1,913 psf Resale vs $2,379 psf New Launch in Pasir Panjang
items.description: In Pasir Panjang, a headline puts resale condos near S$1,913 psf and a new launch near S$2,379 psf. Compare size and dollars, not only psf.

items.title: Canberra Drive EC site draws crowd of 13 bids; top offer of S$825 psf ppr from Santarli-led JV sets record
items.description: The Canberra Drive EC site drew 13 bids, topped at S$825 psf of floor area by a Santarli-led venture. That is land cost, not a unit price.
